Haa Meem
Is raushan kitaab ki qasam
Beshak hum ne ise Arabi Quran qaraar diya hai taake tum samajh sako
Aur yeh hamaare paas Lauh-e-Mahfooz mein nihaayat darja buland aur pur-az-hikmat kitaab hai
Aur kya hum tum logon ko naseehat karne se sirf is liye kinaara-kashi ikhtiyaar kar lein ke tum zyaadati karne waale ho
Aur hum ne tum se pehle waali qaumon mein bhi kitne hi paighambar bhej diye hain
Aur un mein se kisi ke paas koi nabi nahin aaya magar yeh ke un logon ne un ka mazaaq udaaya
To hum ne un se zyaada zabardast logon ko tabaah o barbaad kar diya, aur yeh misaal jaari ho gayi
Aur aap un se sawaal karenge ke zameen o aasmaan ko kis ne paida kiya hai to yaqeenan yahi kahenge ke ek zabardast taaqat waali aur zee-ilm hasti ne khalq kiya hai
Wahi jis ne tumhaare liye zameen ko gehwaara banaaya hai aur us mein raaste qaraar diye hain taake tum raah maaloom kar sako
Aur jis ne aasmaan se ek mu'ayyan miqdaar mein paani naazil kiya, aur phir hum ne us ke zariye murda zameenon ko zinda bana diya, isi tarah tum bhi zameen se nikaale jaaoge
Aur jis ne tamaam jodon ko khalq kiya hai, aur tumhaare liye kashtiyon aur jaanwaron mein sawaari ka saamaan faraaham kiya hai

Taake un ki pusht par sukoon se baith sako, aur phir jab sukoon se baith jaao to apne Parwardigar ki ne'mat ko yaad karo aur kaho ke paak o be-niyaaz hai woh Khuda jis ne is sawaari ko hamaare liye musakhkhar kar diya hai, warna hum is ko qaaboo mein la sakne waale nahin the
Aur bahar-haal hum apne Parwardigar hi ki baargaah mein palat kar jaane waale hain
Aur un logon ne Parwardigar ke liye us ke bandon mein se bhi ek juz (aulaad) qaraar de diya, ke insaan yaqeenan bada khula hua naashukra hai
Sach batao, kya Khuda ne apni tamaam makhlooqaat mein se apne liye ladkiyon ko muntakhab kiya hai aur tumhaare liye ladkon ko pasand kiya hai
Aur jab un mein se kisi ko usi ladki ki bashaarat di jaati hai jo misaal unhon ne Rehmaan ke liye bayaan ki hai to us ka chehra siyaah ho jaata hai aur ghusse ke ghoont peene lagta hai
Kya jis ko zevaraat mein paala jaata hai aur woh jhagde ke waqt saheeh baat bhi na kar sake (wahi Khuda ki aulaad hai)

Aur un logon ne un malaaika ko jo Rehmaan ke bande hain ladki qaraar de diya hai. Kya yeh un ki khilqat ke gawaah hain? To anqareeb un ki gawaahi likh li jaaegi aur phir us ke baare mein sawaal kiya jaaega
Aur yeh kehte hain ke Khuda chaahta to hum un ki parastish na karte. Inhein is baat ka koi ilm nahin hai, yeh sirf andaazon se baat karte hain
Kya hum ne is se pehle inhein koi kitaab di hai jis se yeh tamassuk kiye hue hain
Nahin, balke un ka kehna sirf yeh hai ke hum ne apne baap daada ko ek tareeqe par paaya hai aur hum unhi ke naqsh-e-qadam par hidaayat paane waale hain

Aur isi tarah hum ne aap se pehle ki basti mein koi paighambar nahin bheja magar yeh ke us basti ke khush-haal logon ne yeh keh diya ke hum ne apne baap daada ko ek tareeqe par paaya hai aur hum unhi ke naqsh-e-qadam ki pairwi karne waale hain
To paighambar ne kaha ke chaahe main us se behtar paighaam le aaoon jis par tum ne apne baap daada ko paaya hai? To unhon ne jawaab diya ke hum tumhaare paighaam ke maanne waale nahin hain
Phir hum ne un se badla le liya, to ab dekho ke takzeeb karne waalon ka kya anjaam hua hai
Aur jab Ibraheem ne apne (murabbi) baap aur apni qaum se kaha ke main tumhaare tamaam ma'boodon se bari aur bezaar hoon
Ilaawa us ma'bood ke jis ne mujhe paida kiya hai, ke wahi anqareeb mujhe hidaayat dene waala hai
Aur unhon ne is paighaam ko apni nasl mein ek kalima-e-baaqiya qaraar de diya ke shaayad woh log Khuda ki taraf palat aayein
Balke hum ne un logon ko aur un ke buzurgon ko baraabar aaraam diya yahaan tak ke un ke paas haq aur waazeh rasool aa gaya
Aur jab haq aa gaya to kehne lage ke yeh to jaadoo hai aur hum is ke munkir hain
Aur yeh kehne lage ke aakhir yeh Quran dono bastiyon (Makka o Taaif) ke kisi bade aadmi par kyon nahin naazil kiya gaya hai

To kya yahi log rehmat-e-Parwardigar ko taqseem kar rahe hain? Haalaanke hum ne hi un ke darmiyaan ma'eeshat ko zindagaani-e-duniya mein taqseem kiya hai, aur ba'z ko ba'z se ooncha banaaya hai taake ek doosre se kaam le sakein, aur rehmat-e-Parwardigar un ke jama kiye hue maal o mataa' se kahin zyaada behtar hai
Aur agar aisa na hota ke tamaam log ek hi qaum ho jaayenge to hum Rehmaan ka inkaar karne waalon ke liye un ke ghar ki chhatein aur seedhiyaan jin par yeh chadhte hain sab ko chaandi ka bana dete
Aur un ke ghar ke darwaaze aur woh takht jin par woh takiya laga kar baithte hain
Aur sone ke bhi. Lekin yeh sab sirf zindagaani-e-duniya ki lazzat ka saamaan hai, aur aakhirat Parwardigar ke nazdeek sirf saahibaan-e-taqwa ke liye hai
Aur jo shakhs bhi Allah ke zikr ki taraf se andha ho jaaega hum us ke liye ek Shaitaan muqarrar kar denge jo us ka saathi aur ham-nasheen hoga
Aur yeh shayaateen un logon ko raaste se rokte rehte hain, aur yeh yahi khayaal karte hain ke yeh hidaayat-yaafta hain
Yahaan tak ke jab hamaare paas aayenge to kahenge ke aye kaash hamaare aur us ke darmiyaan mashriq o maghrib ka faasla hota, yeh to bada badtareen saathi nikla
Aur yeh saari baatein aaj tumhaare kaam aane waali nahin hain, ke tum sab azaab mein baraabar ke shareek ho, ke tum ne bhi zulm kiya hai
Paighambar! Kya aap behre ko suna sakte hain ya andhe ko raasta dikha sakte hain, ya use hidaayat de sakte hain jo zalaal-e-mubeen mein mubtala ho jaaye
Phir hum ya to aap ko duniya se utha lenge, to humein to un se bahar-haal badla lena hai
Ya phir azaab aap ko dikha kar hi naazil karenge, ke hum us ka bhi ikhtiyaar rakhne waale hain
Lihaaza aap us hukm ko mazbooti se pakde rahein jis ki wahi ki gayi hai, ke yaqeenan aap bilkul seedhe raaste par hain
Aur yeh Quran aap ke liye aur aap ki qaum ke liye naseehat ka saamaan hai, aur anqareeb tum sab se baaz-purs ki jaaegi
Aur aap un rasoolon se sawaal karein jinhein aap se pehle bheja gaya hai, kya hum ne Rehmaan ke ilaawa bhi khuda qaraar diye hain jin ki parastish ki jaaye
Aur hum ne Moosa alaihis-salaam ko apni nishaaniyon ke saath Fir'aun aur us ke ru'asa-e-qaum ki taraf bheja to unhon ne kaha ke main Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki taraf se rasool hoon
Lekin jab hamaari nishaaniyon ko pesh kiya to woh sab mazhaka udaane lage
Aur hum inhein jo bhi nishaani dikhlaate the woh pehle waali nishaani se badh kar hi hoti thi, aur phir inhein azaab ki giraft mein le liya ke shaayad isi tarah raaste par waapas aa jaayein
Aur un logon ne kaha ke aye jaadoogar (Moosa)! Apne Rab se hamaare baare mein us baat ki dua kar jis baat ka tujh se waada kiya gaya hai, to hum yaqeenan raaste par aa jaayenge
Lekin jab hum ne azaab ko door kar diya to unhon ne ahd ko tod diya

Aur Fir'aun ne apni qaum se pukaar kar kaha: aye qaum! Kya yeh mulk-e-Misr mera nahin hai, aur kya yeh nahrein jo mere qadmon ke neeche jaari hain yeh sab meri nahin hain? Phir tumhein kyon nazar nahin aa raha hai
Kya main us shakhs se behtar nahin hoon jo past haisiyat ka aadmi hai aur saaf bol bhi nahin paata hai
Phir kyon us ke oopar sone ke kangan nahin naazil kiye gaye, aur kyon us ke saath malaaika jama ho kar nahin aaye
Pas Fir'aun ne apni qaum ko subuk-sar bana diya aur unhon ne us ki itaa'at kar li, ke woh sab pehle hi se faasiq aur badkaar the
Phir jab un logon ne humein ghazabnaak kar diya to hum ne un se badla le liya, aur phir unhi sab ko ikattha gharq kar diya
Phir hum ne inhein gaya guzra aur baad waalon ke liye ek namoona-e-ibrat bana diya
Aur jab Ibn-e-Maryam ko misaal mein pesh kiya gaya to aap ki qaum shor machaane lagi
Aur kehne lage ke hamaare khuda behtar hain ya woh? Aur logon ne un ki misaal sirf zidd mein pesh ki thi, aur yeh sab sirf jhagda karne waale the
Warna Eesa alaihis-salaam ek bande the jin par hum ne ne'matein naazil keen aur inhein Bani Israaeel ke liye apni qudrat ka ek namoona bana diya
Aur agar hum chaahte to tumhaare badle malaaika ko zameen mein basne waala qaraar de dete
Aur beshak yeh qiyaamat ki waazeh daleel hai, lihaaza is mein shak na karo aur mera ittibaa' karo ke yahi seedha raasta hai
Aur khabardaar Shaitaan tumhein raah-e-haq se rok na de, ke woh tumhaara khula hua dushman hai

Aur jab Eesa alaihis-salaam un ke paas mo'jizaat le kar aaye to unhon ne kaha ke main tumhaare paas hikmat le kar aaya hoon, aur is liye ke ba'z un masaail ki wazaahat kar doon jin mein tumhaare darmiyaan ikhtilaaf hai, lihaaza Khuda se daro aur meri itaa'at karo
Allah hi mera aur tumhaara Parwardigar hai aur usi ki ibaadat karo ke yahi Siraat-e-Mustaqeem hai
To aqwaam ne aapas mein ikhtilaaf shuroo kar diya. Afsos un ke haal par hai jinhon ne zulm kiya, ke un ke liye dardnaak din ka azaab hai
Kya yeh log sirf is baat ka intezaar kar rahe hain ke achaanak qiyaamat aa jaaye aur inhein us ka sha'oor bhi na ho sake
Aaj ke din saahibaan-e-taqwa ke ilaawa tamaam dost ek doosre ke dushman ho jaayenge
Mere bando! Aaj tumhaare liye na khauf hai aur na tum par huzn o malaal taari hoga
Yahi woh log hain jinhon ne hamaari nishaaniyon par imaan qubool kiya hai aur hamaare itaa'at-guzaar ho gaye hain
Ab tum sab apni biwiyon samet e'zaaz o ehteraam ke saath Jannat mein daakhil ho jaao

Un ke gird sone ki rakaabiyon aur pyaaliyon ka daur chalega, aur wahaan un ke liye woh tamaam cheezein hongi jin ki dil mein khwaahish ho aur jo aankhon ko bhali lagein, aur tum us mein hamesha rehne waale ho
Aur yahi woh Jannat hai jis ka tumhein un aamaal ki bina par waaris banaaya gaya hai jo tum anjaam diya karte the
Is mein tumhaare liye bahut se meve hain jin mein se tum khaaoge
Beshak mujrimeen azaab-e-Jahannam mein hamesha rehne waale hain
Un se azaab munqata nahin hoga aur woh maayoosi ke aalam mein wahaan rahenge
Aur hum ne un par koi zulm nahin kiya hai, yeh to khud hi apne oopar zulm karne waale the
Aur woh aawaaz denge ke aye Maalik! Agar tumhaara Parwardigar humein maut de de to bahut achchha ho. To jawaab milega ke tum ab yahin rehne waale ho
Yaqeenan hum tumhaare paas haq le kar aaye, lekin tumhaari aksariyat haq ko naapasand karne waali hai
Kya unhon ne kisi baat ka muhkam iraada kar liya hai? To hum bhi yeh kaam jaante hain
Ya un ka khayaal yeh hai ke hum un ke raaz aur khufiya baaton ko nahin sun sakte hain? To kyon nahin, hamaare numaainde sab kuch likh rahe hain
Aap keh dijiye ke agar Rehmaan ke koi farzand hota to main sab se pehla ibaadat-guzaar hoon
Woh aasmaan o zameen aur Arsh ka maalik un ki baaton se paak aur munazzah hai
Inhein un ke haal par chhod dijiye, baatein banaate rahein aur khel tamaashe mein lage rahein, yahaan tak ke us din ka saamna karein jis ka waada diya ja raha hai
Aur wahi woh hai jo aasmaan mein bhi khuda hai aur zameen mein bhi khuda hai, aur woh saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai aur har shai se baakhabar bhi hai
Aur ba-barakat hai woh jis ke liye aasmaan o zameen aur us ke maa-bain ka mulk hai, aur usi ke paas qiyaamat ka bhi ilm hai, aur usi ki taraf tum sab waapas kiye jaaoge
Aur us ke ilaawa jinhein yeh log pukaarte hain woh sifaarish ka bhi ikhtiyaar nahin rakhte hain, magar woh jo samajh boojh kar haq ki gawaahi dene waale hain
Aur agar aap un se sawaal karenge ke khud un ka khaaliq kaun hai to kahenge ke Allah. To phir yeh kidhar behke ja rahe hain
Aur usi ko us qaul ka bhi ilm hai ke Khudaaya! Yeh woh qaum hai jo imaan laane waali nahin hai
Lihaaza un se munh mod lijiye aur salaamati ka paighaam de dijiye, phir anqareeb inhein sab kuch maaloom ho jaaega
